comment: Two Zealots of the human player at 20% shields right-click their Shield Battery next to a Pylon and draw shields from it: Order_InitializePsiProvider 0x42f5b0 with the Psi field sprite 0x42f270, UpdateProtossPower 0x430670 with IsPointPowered 0x430000 and the mask 0x42fe60, Follow to a battery (0x428310), RechargeShieldsUnit 0x42f640 with 0x4300e0 and the battery's secondary order 0x42f770.
